companies.label: Meituan
companies.metric_name: Core Local Commerce segment operating profit/(loss)
companies.metric_basis: 核心本地商业经营利润(亏损) — Meituan's disclosed operating profit line for the Core Local Commerce segment (food delivery, Keeta, in-store/Meituan Select), reported each quarter in HKEX filings
companies.latest_signal: Core Local Commerce swung from a RMB2bn loss (-3.2% margin) in Q1 2026 to a RMB5.7bn profit (+7.9% margin) in Q2 2026 as delivery revenue returned to positive YoY growth (+13.1%); management and press both attribute this to regulators halting large indiscriminate subsidies in June 2026 and Alibaba/JD pulling back spend.

companies.label: Alibaba
companies.metric_name: China e-commerce (Taobao & Tmall Group / "Alibaba E-commerce Group" post-restructure) Adjusted EBITA, YoY decline attributed by management to instant-commerce (Taobao Shangou/淘宝闪购) investment
companies.metric_basis: 中国电商事业群(淘天集团)经调整EBITA — Alibaba does not break out a standalone instant-commerce loss line; this segment EBITA and its YoY% decline is the figure management explicitly ties to Taobao Shangou subsidy spend on each call

periods.src: Alibaba FY2026 Q2 results (25 Nov 2025), Sina Finance
Alibaba FY2026 Q3 results (Feb 2026), Yicai/HKEX filing
Alibaba FY2026 Q4/FY results (14 May 2026), Tiger Brokers/Sina

companies.latest_signal: The YoY EBITA drag has collapsed from -76% (Q3 2025) to essentially flat (-1% in Q2 2026); management (CFO Toby Xu) says Taobao Shangou held market share while unit economics improved sequentially each of the last several quarters, with the gap to Meituan's UE narrowing faster than the Street expected.

companies.label: JD.com
companies.metric_name: New Businesses segment operating loss (includes JD Takeaway/外卖, Jingxi, overseas)
companies.metric_basis: 新业务经营亏损 — JD's disclosed New Businesses segment operating loss, the line management explicitly discusses on calls as driven by delivery subsidy investment

periods.src: JD Q2 2026 results call YoY comp, Sina/163
JD Q1 2026 results (13 May 2026), Sina/Eastmoney — mgmt called it the largest-ever sequential narrowing
JD Q2 2026 results (14 Aug 2026), Sina — CFO Sandy Xu: total delivery investment down >50% YoY

companies.latest_signal: New Businesses loss has narrowed for three straight quarters since peaking at -RMB15.7bn in Q3 2025; on the Q2 2026 call management said total delivery-related investment fell over 50% YoY and takeaway commission/ad revenue nearly doubled QoQ, reiterating the unit will eventually be profitable.

war_summary: Subsidy intensity has fallen sharply across all three platforms since regulators (SAMR) explicitly targeted 'involution'-style (内卷式) competition and reportedly curbed large indiscriminate coupon subsidies around June 2026; all three reported their best sequential loss-narrowing in Q2 2026, with Meituan's Core Local Commerce segment flipping back to profit first. Alibaba and JD are still loss-making in instant commerce/delivery but both logged their smallest YoY profit drag/loss to date in Q2 2026 while holding order share, suggesting a negotiated de-escalation rather than a clean winner — Meituan effectively forced the question by letting Q3 2025 losses balloon first, and regulatory pressure did the rest.
